{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Forbidden Treasure}}''' - Upon losing all of its [[Shield Health]], starts summoning [[Hex Wraith]]s and [[Hex Minion]]s from itself with random attributes. |ability1_cooldown = 2 |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Panic Mode}}''' - After losing 70% of its health, gains [[Nimble]], makes [[Aggro]] summons more common and spawns enemies twice as fast. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hex Mimic''' was a summoner enemy that appeared in [[The Nightmare Realm]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a decent amount of health, same as the [[Forsaken Skull]] with [[Shield Health]] included, but was slower than it with its base speed. It had two abilities, both only activated after losing a certain amount of health. The first ability, ''Forbidden Treasure'', was activated upon losing all of its [[Shield Health]]. It would start to spit out [[Hex Wraith]]s and [[Hex Minion]]s from itself with random attributes. Enemies and attributes had specific chances to be chosen. Its second ability was activated when it reached 30% of its health, with that being ''Panic Mode''. This would give the '''Hex Mimic''' the [[Nimble]] attribute and make it summon enemies faster. ==Appearance== The '''Hex Mimic''' was a large brown and grey chest with a light maroon torso, legs and arms. It had large, grey teeth and a red tongue inside of the chest. On top of its chest, it also had multiple grey spikes. It wore brown pants. ==Enemies Summoned== The '''Hex Mimic''' could summon two enemies, that being the [[Hex Wraith]] with a 33.3% chance and the [[Hex Minion]] with a 66.7% chance. These both have a 2 second delay between each spawn. However, each one could spawn with a random attribute, with these being: *None (18.18% chance) *[[Nimble]] (27.27% chance) *[[Bloated]] (9.09% chance) *[[Health Regen]] (18.18% chance) *[[Aggro]] (9.09% chance) *[[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] (18.18% chance) Once in its ''Panic Mode''. Its summons would change. Its minimal delay would be halved and it will gain a second [[Aggro]] modifier in its pool, which has a base weight of 50. This causes the modifier chances to shift: *None (12.5% chance) *[[Nimble]] (18.75% chance) *[[Bloated]] (6.25% chance) *[[Health Regen]] (12.5% chance) *[[Aggro]] (37.5% chance) *[[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] (12.5% chance) ==Strategy== *Early-game towers, like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Cowboy]], [[Militant]] and [[Golden Soldier]] can be quite effective against this. *The '''Hex Mimic''' is a summoner enemy, which can summon enemies with various attributes. **It can summon [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, meaning that hidden detection or towers that can damage them indirectly are needed to deal with this. **It can summon [[Aggro]] enemies, making all your towers target them instead of the enemy they were targeting before. ***Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful in such cases. ***The [[Trapper]] will target these enemies, however, its traps that were placed on the path will still be able to damage other enemies and not the [[Aggro]] enemies. ***Units will target the [[Aggro]] enemy if they have a ranged attack, however, they can still be used to collide with enemies that are in front of it. *Area of effect towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Mortar]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be used to deal damage to both the '''Hex Mimic''' and the enemies it summons. ==Trivia== *The '''Hex Mimic''' is likely based on [[wp:Mimic (Dungeons & Dragons)|Mimics]], a fictional monster appearing in various media that takes the form of a large chest, which when opened generally reveals that it is a living creature with a set of teeth and a tongue. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Hexscape Night 2 Cutscene 1|'''Hex Mimic''' in the opening [[The Nightmare Realm]] cutscene. Hexscape Night 2 Cutscene 2|'''Hex Mimic''' in the ending [[The Nightmare Realm]] cutscene. }} ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Hex Mimic''' added. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Hex Mimic''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Hex Mimic''' removed. {{TheNightmareRealm|[[Forsaken Skull]]|Wave 6|Hex Mimic|Wave 7 (Easy)|hardt2 = Hex Mimic & [[Hex Corpse]]|hardw2 = Wave 7 (Hard)|[[Rotting Terror]] & [[Hex Corpse]]|Wave 8 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Rotting Terror]]|hardw3 = Wave 8 (Hard)}} {{Containment|[[Forsaken Skull]]|Wave 7|Hex Mimic|Wave 9|[[Blight Walker]]|Wave 11}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
